title: Genetically higher BMD is associated with higher knee-osteoarthritis risk yet lower fracture risk: pleiotropy-aware Mendelian-randomisation evidence
description: Analysis code, configuration, and reproduction material for the manuscript "Genetically higher BMD is associated with higher knee-osteoarthritis risk yet lower fracture risk: pleiotropy-aware Mendelian-randomisation evidence" (submitted to Osteoarthritis and Cartilage). The repository contains the full Python/R pipeline (LDSC genetic correlation across 78 phenotype pairs, two-sample Mendelian randomisation with MR-Egger / weighted median / MR-PRESSO / leave-one-out, multivariable MR conditioning on adult height and BMI, colocalisation, MRlap sample-overlap correction, and statistical power) and the derived outputs needed to reproduce every table and figure, including the multivariable-MR height/BMI grid and the colocalisation contrast. v2.7 (this archive) supersedes v2.6/v2.6.1 and consolidates three post-v2.6 adversarial-review remediation batches, all confined to wording, table definitions and interpretive self-consistency: (1) the study is repositioned as a descriptive multi-phenotype genetic-architecture plus triangulation analysis, with the Systemic Osteogenic Set-point explicitly downgraded to a post-hoc interpretive hypothesis, P1-P6/F1-F10 relocated to supplementary and labelled post-hoc, the rho=-1 boundary case identified as a zero-discriminating strawman, and PCA orthogonality stated as neutral; (2) five Reviewer-2 mandatory items - systematic multiplicity control via two analysis-defined families, ancestry mismatch addressed by a European-only FinnGen knee-OA direction-consistency check explicitly declared NOT an independent replication, MRlap configuration transparency, instrument-attrition accounting, and 5-of-10 site scope; (3) two arithmetic-verifiable P0 internal contradictions resolved (Bonferroni fixed-effect 5/5 versus random-effect 0/5 now stated together; Table S27 instrument strength recomputed from its own 31 per-SNP rows: min F 31.2, median 41.8, mean 64.8, aggregate F 63.8, R2 0.063) plus nine P1/P2 items (colocalisation threshold removed from multiplicity control, weighted-median attenuation, MR-PRESSO consistency, reverse-MR power explanation, negative cross-trait intercept, weak conditional instruments, +/-20% absolute-scale uncertainty, 1,980 LD-correlated SNPs rather than independent loci, and two new supplementary sub-tables). No reported beta/SE/p/OR/CI changed relative to v2.6; no statistical analysis was re-run. Seven verification gates remain green. Raw GWAS summary statistics are not redistributed; they are publicly published (cited in the manuscript) and re-derived by the pipeline.
